backlog.spec: Compute all RDKit Descriptors.CalcMolDescriptors per molecule (nan_to_num, clip to +-1e6) and concatenate with Morgan bits as RF features. BBB is strongly driven by TPSA, MW, logP, HBD, so descriptors should help.
backlog.title: Add RDKit 2D descriptors

backlog.spec: Replace fingerprints with only RDKit 2D descriptors (nan_to_num, clip) and keep the RF. Tests whether physchem alone generalizes better across scaffolds.
backlog.title: Descriptors only RF

backlog.spec: Use GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy with radius 2, 2048 bits for the features instead of binary bits, keep the RF.
backlog.title: Morgan counts instead of bits

backlog.spec: Features: RDKit descriptors plus Morgan count fp (1024 bits). Model: LGBMClassifier with 400 trees, learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 15, colsample_bytree 0.3, subsample 0.8, subsample_freq 1, random_state=seed, n_jobs=8, verbose=-1.
backlog.title: LightGBM on descriptors+counts

backlog.spec: Use RDKit descriptors with CatBoostClassifier(iterations=500, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, random_seed=seed, thread_count=8, verbose=0). Replace the RF.
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Swap RandomForest for ExtraTreesClassifier with 500 trees, max_features 0.3, on descriptors plus Morgan bits.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees on descriptors+FP

backlog.spec: Fit an RF and a LightGBM on descriptors+Morgan features and average their predicted probabilities after rank-normalizing each (scipy.stats.rankdata/len).
backlog.title: RF+GBM rank-average ensemble

backlog.spec: Append the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) to the Morgan bits and descriptors for the RF.
backlog.title: MACCS keys added

backlog.spec: Use Morgan radius 1 with 1024 bits plus descriptors; smaller substructures may generalize better to unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Smaller radius Morgan with features

backlog.spec: Use Morgan generator with atom invariants from GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen, radius 2, 2048 bits, counts, combined with descriptors.
backlog.title: FCFP feature-invariant Morgan

backlog.spec: Add count fingerprints from rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator (fpSize 1024) to the features along with descriptors; RF model.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and topological torsion counts

backlog.spec: Set N_TREES=800, MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF=2, max_features='sqrt' on current features to reduce variance and improve AUROC.
backlog.title: RF min_samples_leaf and more trees

backlog.spec: Use class_weight='balanced_subsample' in the RF; BBB data is imbalanced toward positives.
backlog.title: Balanced class weights

backlog.spec: StandardScaler on clipped descriptors then LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=2000). A simple linear model on physchem may extrapolate across scaffolds; use as the sole model.
backlog.title: Logistic regression on scaled descriptors

backlog.spec: Quantile-transform descriptors (QuantileTransformer normal) and fit SVC(C=1, probability=True, random_state=seed) with RBF kernel; return probabilities.
backlog.title: SVM RBF on descriptors

backlog.spec: Compute Tanimoto kernel matrix on Morgan count/bit fingerprints and fit SVC(kernel='precomputed', C=1, probability=True, random_state=seed).
backlog.title: Tanimoto-kernel SVM

backlog.spec: Average the rank-normalized predictions of RF on descriptors+FP, a Tanimoto SVM, and LightGBM on descriptors.
backlog.title: Ensemble RF + Tanimoto SVM + LGBM

backlog.spec: XGBClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.03, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.3, min_child_weight=2, random_state=seed, n_jobs=8) on descriptors + Morgan counts 1024.
backlog.title: XGBoost with small depth

backlog.spec: Average 5 LightGBM models with different seeds (seed+i) and bagging on descriptors, to reduce variance.
backlog.title: Seed-bagged LightGBM

backlog.spec: Drop features with variance below 0.01 (or present in <1% of training molecules) before fitting the RF, computed on training data only, to reduce noise from rare bits.
backlog.title: Feature selection by variance

backlog.spec: Use a small hand-chosen set: MolWt, MolLogP, TPSA, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, NumRotatableBonds, FractionCSP3, RingCount, NumAromaticRings, formal charge, acid/base counts (carboxylic acid, basic amine SMARTS) plus Morgan bits; RF.
backlog.title: Descriptor subset physchem

backlog.spec: Add counts for carboxylic acid, sulfonamide, quaternary N, basic aliphatic amine, and phosphate SMARTS patterns as extra features alongside descriptors and Morgan bits.
backlog.title: Acid/base SMARTS flags

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, use rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser and Uncharger to strip salts and neutralize molecules; then use existing features. Handle failures by falling back to the original mol.
backlog.title: Canonical salt stripping

backlog.spec: Use only the VSA descriptor families (SlogP_VSA, SMR_VSA, PEOE_VSA, EState_VSA) plus TPSA and MolLogP with a LightGBM model; low-dimensional surface features.
backlog.title: Crippen contributions and VSA bins only

backlog.spec: Generate inner 5-fold out-of-fold predictions of RF and LightGBM on training data, then fit a LogisticRegression on those two columns and apply to test predictions from models refit on all training data.
backlog.title: Stacked RF and GBM via logistic blend

backlog.spec: Use sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=15, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=seed) on descriptors; simple and fast.
backlog.title: HistGradientBoosting on descriptors

backlog.spec: Use RandomForestRegressor on 0/1 labels (min_samples_leaf=2, max_features 0.3) on descriptors+Morgan; the continuous output may give better ranking.
backlog.title: Label smoothing for RF via regression

backlog.spec: Compute Murcko scaffold for training molecules and weight each sample by 1/sqrt(scaffold count) in the RF fit so large scaffold clusters do not dominate.
backlog.title: Scaffold-aware sample weights

backlog.spec: Append rdReducedGraphs.GetErGFingerprint (pharmacophore reduced graph) and EState fingerprint sums to descriptors, using RF or LightGBM.
backlog.title: Add ErG and E-state fingerprints

backlog.spec: Concatenate descriptors, MACCS and Morgan counts (1024); average probabilities of RF (500 trees) and ExtraTrees (500 trees, min_samples_leaf=2).
backlog.title: Extra-trees plus RF blend on rich features

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, add a CatBoostClassifier(iterations=500, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, l2_leaf_reg=5, random_seed=seed, thread_count=8, verbose=0) fitted on Dtr (RDKit descriptors only). Append its predict_proba[:,1] on Dte to preds before the rank average. Import CatBoostClassifier from catboost.
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors as 4th member

backlog.spec: Add an SVC(kernel='rbf', C=3, gamma='scale') pipeline member: clip descriptors to the 1st-99th percentile of train, apply sklearn QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal', n_quantiles=200) fitted on train descriptors, StandardScaler, then SVC. Use its decision_function on test as an extra rank-averaged member.
backlog.title: RBF SVM on standardized descriptors

backlog.spec: Add a LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=2000) member trained on QuantileTransformer(normal)-transformed descriptors concatenated with Morgan bits (radius 2, 1024 bits). Its decision_function is rank-averaged into the ensemble as an additional member. Linear model adds diversity with the tree models.
backlog.title: Logistic regression on quantile-scaled descriptors

backlog.spec: Replace np.mean of rank predictions with a weighted mean using weights RF 0.25, Tanimoto SVM 0.4, LGBM 0.35. Keep everything else the same. Tests whether the ensemble weights are suboptimal.
backlog.title: Weighted rank average favoring SVM/GBM

backlog.spec: Replace the binary Tanimoto kernel by a MinMax kernel on Morgan count fingerprints (radius 3, 2048 bits, GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy). Kernel = sum(min(a,b))/sum(max(a,b)), computed by looping over test rows in chunks with numpy broadcasting (chunks of 50 rows) or via the identity min=(a+b-|a-b|)/2. Use it in the precomputed SVC with C=5.
backlog.title: Count-based Tanimoto (MinMax) kernel SVM

backlog.spec: Before featurization and descriptors, parse each SMILES and keep only the largest fragment using rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.GetMolFrags(mol, asMols=True) choosing max by heavy atom count; neutralize with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger. Use the cleaned molecules for all feature calculations in both train and test.
backlog.title: Salt stripping and largest fragment

backlog.spec: Replace the single LightGBM with an average of 5 LGBMClassifier models (different seeds seed+i) with n_estimators=400, learning_rate=0.02, num_leaves=7, min_child_samples=15, reg_lambda=5, colsample_bytree=0.3, subsample=0.7, subsample_freq=1, trained on descriptors plus 512-bit Morgan bits. Average probabilities as one ensemble member.
backlog.title: Seed-bagged LightGBM with stronger regularization

backlog.spec: After computing the initial ensemble prediction on the test set, take the top 15% and bottom 15% most confident test molecules as pseudo-labels (1 and 0), add them to training, and refit the RF and LGBM members. Final output is the rank average of the second round predictions. Use the same seed.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label / transductive self-training

backlog.spec: Replace the RF with a bagging loop of 10 RandomForest models (100 trees each), each trained on a subsample of Murcko scaffold groups (70% of groups, drawn by np.random.RandomState(seed)). Compute scaffolds with MurckoScaffold.MurckoScaffoldSmiles on train_smiles. Average the probabilities. This regularizes toward generalization to unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Scaffold-diverse bagging for RF

backlog.spec: Build a second fingerprint from rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator(fpSize=2048) bit vectors, and compute Tanimoto kernel on it. Average this kernel with the Morgan Tanimoto kernel (0.5/0.5) for the precomputed SVC, for both train-train and test-train kernels.
backlog.title: Add atom-pair and torsion count features to the SVM kernel

incumbent.description: Rank-average ensemble of RF on RDKit descriptors+Morgan FP, a precomputed-kernel Tanimoto SVM, and LightGBM on descriptors.

memo: Helped: only slot 0, the rank-average ensemble (RF on descriptors+Morgan, Tanimoto kernel model, etc.), which cut loss from ~0.1361 to 0.0909. Nothing since has beaten it beyond noise (sd ~0.0049). Slot 2 (cheaper forests, 0.0890, -0.0019) and slot 12 (largest fragment plus neutralization, 0.0896, -0.0013) are within noise, so they are not proven gains. Slot 2 may still save time. Did not help: more RF trees/min leaf (slot 5, 0.0906), descriptor caching (0.0927, 0.0919), functional-group counts (0.0913), physchem-only RF (0.0932), surface-descriptor LightGBM (0.0938). Five of the six crashes (slots 1, 3, 7, 9, 10) involved new models or kernels, including a memory-heavy minmax kernel, so test them cheaply and watch memory. Next: add diversity with CatBoost/XGBoost or an SVM/logistic regression on scaled descriptors, tune the rank-average weights, and try validated stacking. Replicate any candidate under 0.088 before accepting it. Consider combining slots 2 and 12 for speed.
